reserves.name: Digital-asset cash-and-carry strategy
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Spiko cash-and-carry fund and digital-asset counterparties

sources.label: SPKCC prospectus dated February 1, 2026, redemption gates and exceptional settlement

reserveReview.rationale: The live SPKCC fund envelope retains its hedged-crypto classification and unsplit strategy risks. Liquidity is conservatively over seven days: the February 1, 2026 prospectus permits redemption gates over twenty NAVs within a month and exceptional asset-realization settlement up to thirty days; ordinary T+2 dealing is not a whole-position immediate liquidity guarantee. This metadata review does not refresh the July composition or measure underlying weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact live SPKCC aggregate and official cash-and-carry fund disclosure
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The strategy envelope is identified, but current spot, derivative, collateral, venue, and liquidity-buffer weights are not published by the aggregate feed.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The aggregate feed does not split current spot, derivative, margin, venue, and liquidity-buffer exposures.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The prospectus identifies CACEIS Bank as custodian and depositary and CACEIS Fund Administration as accounting and NAV administrator. Provider allocation shares, asset-level segregation and bankruptcy remoteness are not established here. Delegated custody functions may exist; the profile does not establish a current Coinbase spot-custody allocation or infer a fund-wide prohibition on collateral reuse.
